about: Register of public live cameras in Lisboa and the 16 Algarve municipalities. Second pass, 18 Nov 2026. Only pages that were read, or search results where stated, are listed. No stream, frame or snapshot was fetched. Still incomplete.
rules: Official cameras only; the operator's own embed (an iframe from the operator's host) or a link; never record (Dinis, 18 Nov 2026, about 19:00 UTC)
MEO BeachCam included through its official camera pages; embed_allowed is true only where MEO's terms or official offer allow it
Windy webcams API allowed under its terms, attributed; no key held, API not called
Never fetch, store or describe a stream, frame or snapshot
Refusals (403, bot check) recorded as gaps, not worked around; beachcam.meo.pt was not fetched again
No private cameras or directories; private business only with its own public page, flagged

cameras.name: Tejo Live, Câmara Cacilhas
cameras.operator: APL Administração do Porto de Lisboa (Tejo Live)
cameras.status_check: page: the page's HTML has no status or last-updated text; none can be checked without loading the stream, which this register does not do
cameras.terms_summary: Page footer: '© APL Administração do Porto de Lisboa'. No linking or embedding terms found on the page. Page says the feed is about 30 seconds behind and that no image or sound is recorded or stored.
cameras.notes: Sited at Cacilhas on the south bank; shows the estuary between the 25 de Abril and Vasco da Gama bridges and the Lisbon port terminals. Camera stands in Almada, listed under lisboa because the view is of Lisbon. Coordinates are approximate for Cacilhas.
